properties.TITLE: New London Harbor - Shaw Cove Entrance/General/LAA/RNA/Safety Zone
properties.DESCRIPTION:
General/LAA/RNA/Safety Zone

From: 2026-09-11 To: 2027-03-13

Location:
41-21-00.972N/072-05-42.000W

The Coast Guard is establishing a temporary safety zone on September 12, 2026 from 8:15 p.m. through 9:30 p.m. The safety zone will cover all navigable waters of the Thames River encompassing a 600-foot radius at approximate position 41° 21' 01" N, 72° 05' 42" W, in the vicinity of New London Waterfront Park in New London, CT. No vessel or person will be permitted to enter the safety zone without obtaining permission from the COTP or a designated representative. Mariners can contact the person in charge of the Drone Show Jeff Ward during the event at (516) 369-2107
